4th Period.workingNow: Polishing your About Me page — readable colors, resized images, better order, less clutter.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your About Me page with an external CSS stylesheet linked — custom fonts/colors, class/ID selectors, padding/margin, and an organized layout — pushed and ready to submit Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can polish my page for readability so that anyone can look at it once and immediately know what it says.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: I do: model a color and contrast check (8 min)
You do: resize images, reorder, cut clutter (20 min)
Partner check: is it readable at a glance? (10 min)
Commit, push, then Ctrl+Shift+R to check (7 min)
4th Period.connections: You've built this page up all week — content, then a stylesheet, then selectors, then spacing and layout. Today you take everything you've learned and use it to make the page actually easy to read: fix any color that's hard on the eyes, size your images sensibly, reorder what's out of order, and cut what nobody needs. Push it, and it's ready Sunday night.
